title: oenothera boquillensis
intro: Oenothera boquillensis, commonly known as Mexican evening primrose, is a plant species belonging to the evening primrose family (Onagraceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera boquillensis include soothing irritated skin, reducing inflammation, and supporting cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
